title: COMMAND THE NEW DAY WITH POWERFUL MORNING PRAYERS BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Something woke me up before my alarm this morning and I have learned never to ignore that. There is a difference between waking up and being awakened. One is biological, the other is summoned. And when you are summoned before the sun fully rises, it usually means somebody in the unseen realm already knows something about your day that you don't know yet. And heaven wants to get to you before the day gets to you first. So before you scroll into your notifications, before you check what the world has prepared to say to you this morning, I want you to catch your breath right here with me because we are about to do something that most people never do before they step into their day. We are going to take authority over it before it takes authority over us. Open your mouth and say this before we go any further. Father, I take authority over this day before it unfolds. No evil shall prosper against me today. I want you to feel the weight of what you just said because that is not a nice morning affirmation. That is a legal seizure. We will rejoice and be glad in it. Now here is what most people miss when they read that verse casually. The psalmist is not simply expressing gratitude for a pleasant morning. He's making a declaration of ownership. He's saying, "This day belongs to the Lord. It was manufactured by the Lord. And because it was manufactured by him, I refuse to hand its outcome over to chance to circumstance or to the enemy." That's not soft praise. That's a legal statement establishing whose jurisdiction this 24 hours falls under. This tells us that not every day is meant to be identical. There is supposed to be increase attached to your walk with God. Meaning today is not simply a repeat of yesterday. Today carries its own portion, its own assignment, its own increase. And if you walk into it passively, you will miss what was specifically packaged for you inside this next 24 hours. This is why I titled this the way I did because I am convinced that a large number of believers are losing entire seasons not because God has withheld anything from them but because they never took possession of their days one at a time. You cannot govern a year. You have never governed a single morning of authority over a season begins as authority over a sunrise. This is not about religious performance. This is about legal covering. Every day you step into without first taking authority over it in prayer is a day you are walking into with the gates left open.
